name: Simon Emery
source:
A student of Juliet, Simon is a young man of gentle and serious temperament.
His parents died in a fire when he was still a child. Of a rather delicate physique, he had a hard life during his childhood.
One of Juliet's favorite students, even though she avoids showing it to the others by deontology.
